title: Reproducibility package: deep-learning denoising and missing-wedge restoration in cryo-electron tomography (Micron review, Peng_extension)
description: Bounded supplementary reproducibility materials for a Micron review on cryo-ET denoising and missing-wedge restoration. Includes benchmark/recheck scripts, fixed seeds and configuration, source hashes, half-set evaluation arrays (24 metric rows / 48 FSC curves via run_halves.py evaluate), and an official cryoCARE demonstration fit. This is not a new restoration algorithm and not a comprehensive matched-information method benchmark. Upstream CZII and Figshare tutorial data remain under their original terms; see NOTICE.
